title: How much of the field's road-closure content is dynamic (영덕)
why: docs/benchmark/results_v0.1.md §2 put the committed field in the hindcast track and measured that at road nodes it barely differs from persistence at p >= 0.5. The truck-crew replay's corridor closing minute, margin and abort rule are statements about roads over time, so the same question is asked here at the vehicle cutoff on the drive network.
reading: A drive node 「added later」 is one the field says closes DURING the window; a node 「at t = 0」 is already closed before the replay starts. The replay's abort rule can only ever fire on the former.
